# ChinaPatchFactory — Custom Patches Factory in China

> ChinaPatchFactory is a custom patch manufacturer offering factory-direct pricing with no minimum order. We produce embroidered, woven, PVC, leather, metal, chenille, sequin, 3D puff, and sublimation printed patches for brands, teams, clubs, and events worldwide. Free design services, free digital proofs, and fast global shipping.

This site contains in-depth guides covering patch types, materials, backing options, design best practices, and industry applications — useful for anyone researching custom patches or preparing artwork for production.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.chinapatchfactory.com/): Custom patches factory in China with no minimum order, free design and digitizing, factory-direct prices and worldwide shipping
- [Blog](https://www.chinapatchfactory.com/blog.html): All patch guides and articles in one place
